metadata.scenario: A prospect calls to inquire about the services offered at a new spa they noticed while driving by. Category: New Inquiry. Customer type: prospect.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, how can I help you today? Hi, my name is Patricia Wilson, and I was referred by Dr. Anderson. Nice to meet you, Patricia! How can I assist you? Well, my mother is having a hip replacement soon, and we need post-surgery care. I understand. We offer specialized post-surgery recovery care. Oh, that’s great! What does that entail? Our post-surgery recovery care includes assistance with daily activities, medication management, and monitoring her recovery. How long does the service typically last? It can range from 1 to 3 hours per visit, depending on her needs. And what are the costs associated with that? The pricing is between $85 and $110 per visit. That sounds reasonable. Are there any other services that she might need? Yes, we also provide skilled nursing care, which could help with wound care and medication management. Okay, how much is that? It's priced between $95 and $125 for a 1-2 hour visit. I see. What are the hours for these services? Our services are available from 7 AM to 7 PM, Monday through Friday, and 8 AM to 5 PM on Saturdays. Perfect! I think we will need the skilled nursing care along with the post-surgery care. That sounds like a good plan. Would you like me to schedule a consultation for you? Yes, that would be helpful! When can we do that? I can set up a consultation with our Care Coordinator, Lisa Chen. Would tomorrow or the next day work for you? Tomorrow works for me. What time would be best? We have openings at 10 AM or 2 PM. Which do you prefer? Let’s go with 10 AM. Great! I’ll have Lisa call you tomorrow at 10 AM. Thank you! Is there anything else we need to do? Just ensure you have your insurance information ready for the consultation. Will do! Thank you for all your help today. You’re welcome, Patricia! We look forward to assisting your mother. Have a great day! You too! Goodbye. Goodbye!
